polityNote: Spanish Guinea (colony; districts from 1935-04-16), Spanish provinces of Fernando Póo and Río Muni (1960-04-01), autonomous region (1963-12-20), Republic of Equatorial Guinea from 1968-10-12. Spanish Guinea is not in the Müller-Crepon colonial cross-sections (British and French colonies only). Atoms: the seven provinces of geoBoundaries GNQ ADM1 (OpenStreetMap/Wambacher 2016, ODbL); the two-unit layer is island vs mainland, so it is a union of whole provinces by geography. The scope ends before Djibloho (cut from Wele-Nzas) because the atoms predate it.
